en: A black-and-white street scene showing a calm town street lined with two- and three‑story buildings, trees along the sidewalks, pedestrians walking, and a horse‑drawn cart in the middle distance. The architecture is Northern European, with wooden facades and steep roofs. At the bottom left, the caption identifies the view as a street in Vänersborg, and at the bottom right are credits to the photographer/publisher.
